title: Document live CLI build prerequisites
summary: Make the live-test documentation explicit that cross-crate CLI live tests execute target/debug/covenant and therefore require cargo build -p covenant before targeted live runs.
expectedFailureModes: A targeted live CLI test uses a stale target/debug/covenant binary.
Operators run the documented command and get a misleading unknown-command failure.
The full quick gate passes while an isolated live CLI command fails because the binary prerequisite is implicit.
nextAction: Integrated locally; keep targeted live-test command docs aligned with actual binary lookup behavior.
